messages:
marco: Heads-up — I'm going to land a small change to gateway routing rules that prefers `X-Run-Context` when present, otherwise falls back to UA inference. Want to flag any quota/telemetry gaps before I open the PR.

yana: What exact header precedence are you proposing? current stack is messy with X-Run-Context, X-Customer, and token-derived tenant.

marco: Proposed order: 1) Signed routing header (`X-Route-Signature` + `X-Run-Context`), 2) `X-Customer-ID` (explicit customer header), 3) Authorization-derived tenant, 4) User-Agent heuristics.

felix: Can we avoid changing quota attribution? lots of consumers expect quotas to be tied to the token. If we switch to header-first we could undercount or mis-bill.

marco: Good call. Plan is: routing decision uses header precedence above, but billing/quotas will still prefer token-derived tenant unless a config flag in the console says "Use header for billing". Default = token.

liz: That console flag needs a rollout UX. We should never enable header billing by default. Maybe a canary toggle + audit log that shows which requests used header billing.

marco: Agreed. Rollout plan: dev -> 10% beta tenants who opt-in in console -> 100% for tenant if they explicitly set. Also add an admin override to force-header-billing for emergency routing.

yana: Telemetry: add a metric `gateway.routing.source` with tags `header|token|ua`. Also increment a counter for `routing.signature_valid:true/false`. Otherwise we can't measure spoof attempts.

marco: Adding now. Also adding a trace annotation `routing.header_used` and an event when signature verification fails.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: please include unit tests for precedence, e2e test hitting canary toggle, and a telemetry smoke test.

felix: Edge case: mobile SDKs sometimes strip custom headers. If a legitimate customer loses `X-Run-Context`, UA inference might pick wrong tenant. Need a safe fallback policy and a short TTL for header-based affinity.

marco: Good note. I'll set header-affinity TTL=30s and require signature TTL=5m. Also returning a `x-routing-assertion` header downstream so services can validate source.

liz: Console UX: for the canary toggle, show counts of requests and how many used header vs token. Also surface top 5 UAs where header was present but signature invalid.

yana: Security: how are we signing `X-Run-Context`? symmetric HMAC with per-tenant key via KMS? or a central key? Signing needs rotation plan.

marco: Per-tenant HMAC via KMS if available, fallback to shared key for older tenants. We'll store key metadata in the tenant record. Rotation: generate new key, accept old key for 24h during rollout.

felix: Need to audit performance: signature verification adds CPU. We should only verify for requests that actually affect routing (i.e., if header present and matches a known tenant) and cache verification results for the TTL.

marco: Yep — cache verification in mempool keyed by signature + tenant for 30s. Also fast-fail if tenant disabled signatures.

yana: Test snippet for QA:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Run-Context: tenant=acme;env=prod" \
  -H "X-Route-Signature: sha256=..." \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```
Check response headers for `x-routing-source` and trace id.

marco: I'll add integration test that uses a signed header, unsigned header, and missing header. Also a test where header points to a different tenant than token — ensure routing chooses header but billing uses token unless console override set.

liz: One more: quota enforcement vs fallback. If header routing forwards to dedicated pool and that pool is over quota, fallback should hit public pool and we should tag the event for billing reconciliation.

marco: Implementing fallback policy: on pool-saturated => try region fallback => try public fallback => return 429 if none available. Tag events `fallback.reason` and `fallback.path`.

sre-bot: incident-sim: simulate header spoofing attempt on staging in 30m. Please subscribe if you want to watch.

felix: subscribing. Also can we log the raw header when signature invalid for debugging (but redact token and PII)?

marco: We'll persist a redacted copy: remove any user-identifying fields, keep tenant id and signature. Add retention 7d for debugging only.

yana: Sounds good overall. Please put PR link here when ready. Also @security please review signing scheme. :eyes:

marco: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pull/312 — includes precedence logic, console toggle, metrics, and tests. Planning rollout tomorrow 06:00 UTC to opt-in tenants.

liz: I'll prepare console copy and canary UX docs. QA team — please validate telemetry and billing behavior for 10% canary.

felix: Quick note — update infra infra-alerts: increase cpu threshold for gateways by 10% during rollout window.

marco: thanks all. I'll wait 2h for any objections then merge.
